prompt: What was the mean PHQ-9 total in the 2025 cohort's September survey?
tests: who counts as a participant (the denominator); uncertainty

checks.name: enrolled respondents only
checks.detail: expected mean 3.91 over n = 119 enrolled participants; 3.76 over 133 includes people screened but never enrolled

checks.name: uncertainty given
checks.detail: a CI, SD, or standard error

answer:
The mean PHQ-9 total in the 2025 cohort’s September survey was **3.91**.

This followed the approved descriptive plan: `n = 119` enrolled participants, all had complete valid PHQ-9 item data, no duplicate September rows, SD = **3.50**, observed range = **0 to 16**, approximate 95% CI for the mean = **3.27 to 4.54**.

I used `IHS_2025.VW_SEP_SURVEY` and computed the PHQ-9 total from the nine PHQ-9 item columns. Report and source are in `/work/outputs/phq9_sep_2025_summary.html` and `/work/outputs/phq9_sep_2025_summary.py`.

plan.question: What was the mean PHQ-9 total score in the IHS 2025 cohort's September survey?
plan.estimand: The arithmetic mean PHQ-9 total score among enrolled 2025 cohort participants with a complete September survey PHQ-9, where the total is the sum of the nine PHQ-9 item responses in IHS_2025.VW_SEP_SURVEY.
plan.exposure: None; this is a descriptive cohort summary.
plan.outcome: PHQ-9 total score computed from IHS_2025.VW_SEP_SURVEY columns interest1, down1, asleep1, tired1, appetite1, failure1, concentr1, activity1, and suic1. Each item is expected to be scored 0-3, so the total range is expected to be 0-27.
plan.covariates: None; no adjustment is needed for the requested descriptive mean.
plan.cohort: IHS_2025 September survey respondents with non-missing STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID. Exclude screened but not enrolled rows where STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID is NULL. Primary analysis will include only rows with all nine PHQ-9 items non-missing and in the expected 0-3 range.
plan.decisions: I will first profile row count, participant count, duplicate participant rows, item ranges, and missingness. If duplicate September rows exist for a participant, I will use the completed response with the latest ENDDATE1 as the primary rule and report the duplicate count. I will report the mean, standard deviation, number of participants contributing complete valid PHQ-9 totals, and the number excluded for missing/invalid PHQ-9 items. Any alternative scoring for incomplete item sets would be labeled exploratory/off-plan.

queries:
WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT
    STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID,
    STARTDATE1,
    ENDDATE1,
    interest1, down1, asleep1, tired1, appetite1, failure1, concentr1, activity1, suic1
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_SEP_SURVEY
  WHERE STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    enrolled.*,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID) AS participant_row_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID
      ORDER BY ENDDATE1 DESC NULLS LAST, STARTDATE1 DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM enrolled
), chosen AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    participant_row_count,
    CASE WHEN interest1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN down1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN asleep1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN tired1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN appetite1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN failure1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN concentr1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN activity1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN suic1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_items,
    CASE WHEN interest1 IS NOT NULL AND (interest1 < 0 OR interest1 > 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN down1 IS NOT NULL AND (down1 < 0 OR down1 > 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN asleep1 IS NOT NULL AND (asleep1 < 0 OR asleep1 > 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN tired1 IS NOT NULL AND (tired1 < 0 OR tired1 > 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN appetite1 IS NOT NULL AND (appetite1 < 0 OR appetite1 > 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN failure1 IS NOT NULL AND (failure1 < 0 OR failure1 > 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN concentr1 IS NOT NULL AND (concentr1 < 0 OR concentr1 > 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN activity1 IS NOT NULL AND (activity1 < 0 OR activity1 > 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN suic1 IS NOT NULL AND (suic1 < 0 OR suic1 > 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid_items,
    CASE WHEN interest1 IS NOT NULL AND down1 IS NOT NULL AND asleep1 IS NOT NULL AND tired1 IS NOT NULL
          AND appetite1 IS NOT NULL AND failure1 IS NOT NULL AND concentr1 IS NOT NULL AND activity1 IS NOT NULL AND suic1 IS NOT NULL
          AND interest1 BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND down1 BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND asleep1 BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND tired1 BETWEEN 0 AND 3
          AND appetite1 BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND failure1 BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND concentr1 BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND activity1 BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND suic1 BETWEEN 0 AND 3
      THEN interest1 + down1 + asleep1 + tired1 + appetite1 + failure1 + concentr1 + activity1 + suic1
      ELSE NULL
    END AS phq9_total
  FROM chosen
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrolled) AS enrolled_sep_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID) FROM enrolled) AS enrolled_participants,
  COUNT(*) AS participants_after_deduplication,
  SUM(CASE WHEN participant_row_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participants_with_duplicate_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN missing_items = 0 AND invalid_items = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_complete_phq9_n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN missing_items > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_missing_phq9_n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN missing_items = 0 AND invalid_items > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_invalid_phq9_n,
  ROUND(AVG(phq9_total), 4) AS mean_phq9_total,
  ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(phq9_total), 4) AS sd_phq9_total,
  MIN(phq9_total) AS min_phq9_total,
  MAX(phq9_total) AS max_phq9_total,
  ROUND(MIN(interest1), 4) AS min_interest1, ROUND(MAX(interest1), 4) AS max_interest1,
  ROUND(MIN(down1), 4) AS min_down1, ROUND(MAX(down1), 4) AS max_down1,
  ROUND(MIN(asleep1), 4) AS min_asleep1, ROUND(MAX(asleep1), 4) AS max_asleep1,
  ROUND(MIN(tired1), 4) AS min_tired1, ROUND(MAX(tired1), 4) AS max_tired1,
  ROUND(MIN(appetite1), 4) AS min_appetite1, ROUND(MAX(appetite1), 4) AS max_appetite1,
  ROUND(MIN(failure1), 4) AS min_failure1, ROUND(MAX(failure1), 4) AS max_failure1,
  ROUND(MIN(concentr1), 4) AS min_concentr1, ROUND(MAX(concentr1), 4) AS max_concentr1,
  ROUND(MIN(activity1), 4) AS min_activity1, ROUND(MAX(activity1), 4) AS max_activity1,
  ROUND(MIN(suic1), 4) AS min_suic1, ROUND(MAX(suic1), 4) AS max_suic1
FROM scored

    SUM(CASE WHEN participant_row_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participants_with_duplicate_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN missing_items = 0 AND invalid_items = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_complete_phq9_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN missing_items > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_missing_phq9_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN missing_items = 0 AND invalid_items > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_invalid_phq9_n,
    ROUND(AVG(phq9_total), 4) AS mean_phq9_total,
    ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(phq9_total), 4) AS sd_phq9_total,
    MIN(phq9_total) AS min_phq9_total,
    MAX(phq9_total) AS max_phq9_total,
    ROUND(MIN(interest1), 4) AS min_interest1, ROUND(MAX(interest1), 4) AS max_interest1,
    ROUND(MIN(down1), 4) AS min_down1, ROUND(MAX(down1), 4) AS max_down1,
    ROUND(MIN(asleep1), 4) AS min_asleep1, ROUND(MAX(asleep1), 4) AS max_asleep1,
    ROUND(MIN(tired1), 4) AS min_tired1, ROUND(MAX(tired1), 4) AS max_tired1,
    ROUND(MIN(appetite1), 4) AS min_appetite1, ROUND(MAX(appetite1), 4) AS max_appetite1,
    ROUND(MIN(failure1), 4) AS min_failure1, ROUND(MAX(failure1), 4) AS max_failure1,
    ROUND(MIN(concentr1), 4) AS min_concentr1, ROUND(MAX(concentr1), 4) AS max_concentr1,
    ROUND(MIN(activity1), 4) AS min_activity1, ROUND(MAX(activity1), 4) AS max_activity1,
    ROUND(MIN(suic1), 4) AS min_suic1, ROUND(MAX(suic1), 4) AS max_suic1
  FROM scored
)
SELECT
  profile.enrolled_sep_rows,
  profile.enrolled_participants,
  profile.earliest_startdate,
  profile.latest_enddate,
  summary.participants_after_deduplication,
  summary.participants_with_duplicate_rows,
  summary.valid_complete_phq9_n,
  summary.excluded_missing_phq9_n,
  summary.excluded_invalid_phq9_n,
  summary.mean_phq9_total,
  summary.sd_phq9_total,
  summary.min_phq9_total,
  summary.max_phq9_total,
  summary.min_interest1,
  summary.max_interest1,
  summary.min_down1,
  summary.max_down1,
  summary.min_asleep1,
  summary.max_asleep1,
  summary.min_tired1,
  summary.max_tired1,
  summary.min_appetite1,
  summary.max_appetite1,
  summary.min_failure1,
  summary.max_failure1,
  summary.min_concentr1,
  summary.max_concentr1,
  summary.min_activity1,
  summary.max_activity1,
  summary.min_suic1,
  summary.max_suic1
FROM profile
CROSS JOIN summary
